recipe.goal: calibrate ALMA data and check source
recipe.method: standard ALMA calibration; amplitude and phase from the J1427-4206 scan applied to the whole observation; phase referencing on J1452-6502 for target and check source J1424-6807
key_parameters: antenna/spectral-window scale factor constant within 5% over the observation

recipe.goal: image each observation and measure fluxes
recipe.method: tclean images per observation (briggs robust 0, 2048x2048 at 5 mas), Gaussian fit with imfit for fluxes; positions from images, not uv analysis
key_parameters: 5 mas grid, 2048x2048 pixels covering nearly all of the primary beam

recipe.goal: measure absolute positions and calibrate their accuracy
recipe.method: jmfit positions per one-hour observation on the ICRS frame, averaged per pair; accuracy from check source and pair differences
key_parameters: adopted absolute uncertainty 3 mas (2019 July and August) and 6 mas (2018 October)
assumptions: check source to phase calibrator separation 4.1 deg is similar to alpha Cen to phase calibrator (4.5 deg), so offsets transfer after SNR scaling

recipe.goal: measure the A-B differential separation after self-calibration
recipe.method: phase self-calibration on both stars, then jmfit of the A-B separation per epoch
key_parameters: separation uncertainties 0.3 to 0.6 mas from positional fitting
assumptions: atmospheric distortions act nearly identically on A and B

recipe.goal: estimate astrometric jitter from stellar activity
recipe.method: fit SED with BT-Settle photosphere plus free-free chromosphere to get photospheric and chromospheric fractions in Band 7, then scale solar 17 GHz centroid shifts (2001 and 2010) by stellar diameters and chromospheric fraction
assumptions: starspots of ~4000 K on a 5800 K photosphere
Sun is a template for solar-like activity of alpha Cen A and B

recipe.goal: fit orbit from RV plus differential astrometry
recipe.method: Keplerian two-body model fit for epoch 2019.5 to RVs and differential astrometry, with perspective and light-time corrections applied in a second fitting round
key_parameters: 2 m/s uniform jitter added in quadrature to RVs; RVs with sigma > 10 m/s rejected; 5 sigma clipping (0.9% of A, 1.0% of B)
assumptions: reference epoch 2019.5 chosen to match the majority of the ALMA data; second-order effects treated as linear perturbations
intrinsic RV shift of A taken as zero

recipe.goal: determine barycentric proper motion and parallax check
recipe.method: adopt dynamical parallax and mass ratio, compute barycentre positions at Hipparcos and ALMA epochs, fit linear space motion
key_parameters: ALMA absolute positions assigned 3 mas (6 mas for Oct 2018); 10 absolute points in total

recipe.goal: derive stellar masses, radii and luminosities
recipe.method: masses from fitted total mass and mass fraction; radii from limb-darkened angular diameters and the new parallax; luminosities from bolometric fluxes

recipe.goal: estimate planet detection limits and Proxima binding
recipe.method: scale ALMA single-epoch accuracy (500, 250, 100 uas; 20 epochs over 5 yr) against PRV limits; compare AB-Proxima differential velocity with escape limit
assumptions: differential astrometric performance continues to scale with baseline length
